title: Three controls protect three deployment requirements
rows: Keep original web capacity during validation
Beanstalk Immutable adds a temporary fleet; quotas must allow it.
CodeDeploy shifts alias traffic with hooks, alarms, and rollback.
Stop later releases after a failure
Pipeline failure gate stays closed until an operator clears it.
footnote: Backward-compatible code and data are assumed. Rollback does not itself lock future pipeline executions.
